zh-CN.title: 修复嵌套聊天消息对齐
items: 修复自己发送的合并记录中，他方消息被外层布局错误推向右侧的问题
手机端内嵌预览会使用当前生效的聊天背景
完整预览及其内部嵌套记录保持一致的消息方向和背景

en.title: Fixed nested chat alignment
items: Fixed incoming messages inside outgoing merged records being incorrectly aligned to the right by the outer layout
Inline previews on mobile now use the active chat background
Full previews and their nested records keep message direction and backgrounds consistent
